Samir (partnerships): Heads up — supplier sent a cutaway notice. They're shipping ~40% of the reserved racks this week, remaining 60% delayed until late next month. Affects marketplace reservations for SKU JN-42 and the multi-cloud pool. :package:
Maya (supply-chain): ugh. do we have the PO / shipment manifest yet? what's the ETA range? :thinking_face:
Samir (partnerships): Manifest just landed, short on GPUs and some PSU kits. ETA says 'late-May to early-June' for remainder. Vendor cites port congestion + part split. I'll paste manifest in a sec.
OrionBot: Vendor manifest uploaded: `manifest_2165432098.csv` (s3://vendor-manifests/2165432098)
Ethan (cloud-partners): Can we rebalance committed marketplace capacity across regions? If APAC supply is hit, maybe we shift some EU-backed reserved slots to serve APAC customers temporarily. Any constraints from the marketplace mapping?
Samir (partnerships): We can reassign marketplace reservations but need partner consent for SKU-region remap. Two dedicated customers have pinned JN-42 in APAC (total 120 GPUs). We have 48 GPUs available in EU reserved buffer.
Lina (sales): Who are the dedicated customers? Need to assess SLAs before moving. If we shift, do we owe credits? Also some enterprise trials start next week — we can't break those.
Maya (supply-chain): Quick allocation table I made: 
```
Region | Reserved (JN-42) | Buffer | Committed to customers
APAC   | 168              | 16     | 120
EU     | 96               | 48     | 20
US     | 72               | 8      | 40
```
Samir (partnerships): Proposal: 1) Offer APAC customers temporary cross-region routing using EU pool for burst (max 48 GPUs). 2) Ask vendor for partial expedited airlift for critical PSUs (quote requested). 3) Notify affected customers with an ETA window and mitigation plan.
Ethan (cloud-partners): +1 for cross-region routing as a short-term mitigation. Need operations to validate latency and network egress costs. I can loop in infra.
Lina (sales): Prepare a customer notice draft. Keep it transparent, mention mitigation and expected dates. If promos/credits needed, finance needs heads-up.
Maya (supply-chain): I'll request expedited airlift costs now and ask vendor for binding commit on next shipment date. Samir, can you coordinate partner consent for the marketplace remap?
Samir (partnerships): On it. I'll ping the partner rep and share the proposed remap and template notice. ETA: will have partner reply by EOD.
Ethan (cloud-partners): FYI I've flagged this to infra on priority — testing cross-region routing with a small canary 4-GPU job to validate perf.
Lina (sales): Thanks. Once we have partner answer and infra test pass, I'll send the customer note + CS playbook.
Samir (partnerships): Action items:
- Samir: partner consent + vendor airlift request (today)
- Maya: confirm exact missing SKUs + expedited cost (1–2 hrs)
- Ethan: canary routing test (4 GPUs) and cost estimate (3 hrs)
- Lina: customer notice draft (standby)
Will update thread when partner responds. :white_check_mark:
